programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: Two rival radio producers race to get an audience-participation program off the ground and over the airwaves.

programme.title: Zorba the Greek
programme.desc: A lusty Greek peasant (Anthony Quinn) shows a British writer (Alan Bates) how to live and run a lignite mine.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: In a society where life ends at age 30, a law enforcement officer known as a Sandman (Michael York) flees with another 30-year-old (Jenny Agutter) when he learns his number has come up prematurely.

programme.title: All About Eve
programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.

programme.title: Meet John Doe
programme.desc: A reporter writes a fictitious column about a man named John Doe, who claims to despair at America's neglect of the little people and plans to kill himself. To maintain the ruse, the newspaper hires a ballplayer-turned-hobo to pose as John Doe.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
programme.desc: An outlaw (Henry Fonda) working for a railroad magnate fights a stranger (Charles Bronson) for a New Orleans widow's (Claudia Cardinale) land.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: A retired cat burglar (Cary Grant) sees fireworks with an American heiress (Grace Kelly) on the Riviera.

programme.title: Blue Hawaii
programme.desc: After returning to Hawaii from being in the army, a pineapple tycoon's rebellious son turns into an island tour guide with his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: A drifter (John Garfield) stops at a Greek diner and helps the owner's (Cecil Kellaway) lusty wife (Lana Turner) become a widow.

programme.title: The Cape Town Affair
programme.desc: An American secret agent tries to retrieve a roll of microfilm in South Africa before it falls into communist hands.

programme.title: Divorce American Style
programme.desc: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

programme.title: White Comanche
programme.desc: A peace officer settles a quarrel between twins, the offspring of an American Indian mother and a white father.

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: A French diplomat (Jean-Pierre Aumont) falls for a recent graduate (Ginger Rogers) of a Paris school for pickpockets.

programme.title: Julie
programme.desc: A stewardess (Doris Day) runs for her life once she realizes her second husband (Louis Jourdan) killed her first.

programme.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman
programme.desc: A 110-year-old former Louisiana slave (Cicely Tyson) reminisces about her life and society from the Civil War to germinating civil rights.

programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.

programme.title: Road to Utopia
programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).

programme.title: The Long, Hot Summer
programme.desc: A small-town Mississippi boss tries to pair his daughter (Joanne Woodward) with an enigmatic drifter (Paul Newman).

programme.title: The Silencers
programme.desc: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.

programme.title: The Girl Can't Help It
programme.desc: An agent (Tom Ewell) turns the girlfriend (Jayne Mansfield) of a former gangster (Edmond O'Brien) into a rock 'n' roll star.

programme.title: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers
programme.desc: A space scientist (Hugh Marlowe) figures out how to down a fleet of alien spacecraft looming over Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Belle Starr
programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.

programme.desc: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.

programme.desc: The happiness of a second marriage is destroyed after a firefighter is felled by gun violence in front of his own home; his family, police and fellow firefighters search for justice and find out that the killer is someone he trusted with his life.

programme.title: A Wedding and a Murder
programme.desc: A motocross champion and a model tie the knot in Las Vegas, never knowing their wedding vows will trigger a mysterious murder plot and a decades-long investigation.

programme.title: A Wedding and a Murder
programme.desc: After a man is found murdered, detectives search for a motive in the seemingly senseless slaying; after considering whether it was a case of mistaken identity or a robbery, investigators ask if secret desires caused a killer to strike in God's name.

programme.title: Catfish Murders
programme.desc: A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online; her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader.

programme.title: Catfish Murders
programme.desc: When a promising young boxer is found murdered after arranging a date on Facebook, detectives follow his digital trail and uncover a sinister deception that suggests he may not have been the only target.

programme.title: Catfish Murders
programme.desc: When a New Hampshire handyman disappears after receiving a call from a stranger, investigators follow a trail of clues that leads to a connection and a carefully concealed motive.

programme.title: Homicide for the Holidays
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death while driving her sons home from a Thanksgiving celebration; the hunt for her killer leads to an unlikely suspect, making investigators realize her murder is not as random as it seems.

programme.title: Homicide for the Holidays
programme.desc: A Thanksgiving feast turns into a family's last when a cold-blooded killer brutally stabs and dismembers a couple the day after their holiday celebration.

programme.title: Homicide for the Holidays
programme.desc: A prominent couple are found brutally murdered in their Montgomery, Ala., home on Thanksgiving night, leading detectives on a cat-and-mouse chase spanning thousands of miles across multiple states.

programme.title: Homicide for the Holidays
programme.desc: A beloved college co-ed is murdered while jogging over Thanksgiving weekend in Acme, Washington; decades later, an intrepid co-worker plays an unexpected role in bringing her killer to justice.

programme.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
programme.desc: The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

programme.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
programme.desc: A Houston professor is found bludgeoned to death in his high-rise condo. His ex-girlfriend claims she fought for her life with the only weapon within reach: her high-heel shoe. Prosecutors must prove where self-defense ends and murder begins.

programme.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
programme.desc: When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

programme.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
programme.desc: A teacher hosting a family birthday party is shot dead by an angry neighbor who captures the confrontation on camera; the shooter claims the video proves self-defense, but prosecutors say it shows he staged the showdown to get away with murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Serial arsonist on the loose leaves no evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man becomes the prime suspect in his wife's death after forensic science raises questions about her apparent suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Investigators on both sides of the Atlantic seek links between three homicides that look like professional executions.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Who put a bomb in the home of a 29-year-old woman and killed her?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A killer tried to destroy everything which could link them to the crime; but in doing so, they inadvertently created new forensic evidence, evidence which came to light using a technique never before used in a criminal investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When murder strikes a young girl, police quickly make an arrest, but cutting-edge technology from NASA proves they have the wrong suspect behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man is found strangled and burned in his San Antonio apartment and the killer thinks he has destroyed all the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When two men appear to die of heart disease six years apart, police notice they have one thing in common, they were each married to the same woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Casino security cameras offer the final images of a woman, just before she vanishes without a trace; can these grainy images lead police to her killer?

programme.title: Forensic Files
